modules.name: Team Management
modules.description: Multi-user: invite by email, roles (admin/dpo/member/board), seat limits from subscription plan.
modules.notes: Required before M12 (billing reads seat limits) and M14 (onboarding invites DPO).

modules.name: Billing + Subscription Engine
modules.description: Razorpay integration, plan selection, trial management (days from DB), feature gates, billing dashboard.
modules.notes: Full schema in Implementation_Planner/08_Subscription_Engine_Design.md.

modules.name: PAYG Credits Engine
modules.description: Credit wallet, usage metering, per-feature PAYG pricing (from DB), auto-upgrade prompt.
modules.notes: Atomic deduct via Supabase RPC (deduct_payg_credits) to prevent race conditions.

modules.name: Onboarding Wizard
modules.description: 6-step self-serve setup: company profile, Compass assessment, invite DPO, consent widget, plan selection, completion.
modules.notes: Adds onboarding_complete and onboarding_step_completed columns to organizations table.

modules.name: WhatsApp Consent
modules.description: Collect, record, and withdraw DPDP consent via WhatsApp Business API (Twilio). Bulk send campaigns.
modules.notes: Uses Twilio WhatsApp Business API. Consents stored in existing consent_records table with channel='whatsapp'.

modules.name: Aadhaar OTP Verification
modules.description: Optional Aadhaar OTP identity verification before processing DSR requests. Falls back to email OTP if unavailable.
modules.notes: Feature-flagged per org. Requires TSP API credentials. Never stores full Aadhaar number.

modules.name: Trust Center
modules.description: Public per-org compliance page at /trust/[slug]. Shows Compass Score, privacy notices, DSR/grievance links, breach disclosures.
modules.notes: Only DPDP platform with a public per-org trust page. Key differentiator.

modules.name: Alert Center
modules.description: Centralized compliance alerts: overdue DSRs, breach deadlines, expiring vendors, trial ending. Daily cron generation.
modules.notes: Daily cron at 6AM IST. Critical alerts also sent via email immediately.

modules.name: Re-Consent Campaign
modules.description: Bulk campaigns to re-obtain consent after privacy policy updates. Track response rates.
modules.notes: HMAC token per recipient. Legally required when privacy notice changes under DPDP Act.

modules.name: Implementation Tracker Dashboard
modules.description: Internal admin dashboard at /dashboard/admin/tracker showing all 35 modules, rollout milestones, session log.
modules.notes: Reads from tracker-data.json. Migration path to Supabase table when needed.

modules.name: Sector Packs
modules.description: Industry-specific DPDP compliance templates for 6 verticals: Healthcare, Finance, ITES, E-commerce, Education, Manufacturing.
modules.notes: Pre-built ROPA entries, assessment questions, consent templates per sector.

modules.name: TrustStack™ Academy
modules.description: In-platform DPDP compliance training: 5 courses, quizzes, AI-generated PDF certificates.
modules.notes: V1: text-only courses (Markdown). Certificate verification URL is public.

modules.name: Compliance Badge
modules.description: Embeddable dynamic SVG badge for org website and LinkedIn. Real-time compliance status.
modules.notes: SVG cached 1 hour. Badge revoked if Compass Score drops below 70.

modules.name: DPO-as-a-Service
modules.description: Monthly DPO advisory: session booking, async Q&A, session notes. ₹8K-₹30K/month add-on.
modules.notes: Highest ACV add-on. Separate subscription from platform plan.

modules.name: India DSR Connectors
modules.description: Pre-built connectors to auto-fulfill DSR requests from Salesforce, Zoho, Google Workspace, MySQL, Shopify.
modules.notes: Credentials stored in Supabase Vault (never in DB). V1: 5 connectors.

modules.name: DPDP Public API
modules.description: REST API for B2B2C and developer integrations. API key auth, rate limiting, OpenAPI docs.
modules.notes: API keys hashed (SHA-256) — never stored plaintext. Rate limits per plan tier.

modules.name: AI Governance Module
modules.description: AI model registry, training data consent chain, automated decision opt-out, bias audit log.
modules.notes: Extends Compass Assessment with AI-specific questions when org uses AI models.

modules.name: Consent Propagation Engine
modules.description: Auto-propagate consent withdrawal to all connected systems (Salesforce, Zoho, Google). SLA: 30 min.
modules.notes: Most technically complex DPDP requirement. Only Indian platform to automate this.

modules.name: ISO 27701 Pathway
modules.description: Guided ISO 27701 certification prep: 76 controls gap assessment, evidence collection, audit-ready PDF pack.
modules.notes: TrustStack doesn't issue certs — helps orgs prepare for accredited auditors.

modules.name: Data Discovery
modules.description: Automated PII scanning of connected databases/SaaS. Shadow processing map. Never stores actual PII.
modules.notes: CRITICAL: scanner reads sample rows but NEVER stores PII values. Only stores column locations.

modules.name: Privacy-as-Code
modules.description: npm SDK (@truststack/privacy), GitHub Action for PR scanning, ESLint plugin for direct PII queries.
modules.notes: External repos: @truststack/privacy (npm) + truststack-github-action. SDK buffers offline events.
